policy.description: Blocking line-coverage ratchets. For a fixed scope, coveredLines is the highest value in the reviewed clean-run observation envelope, never a modal or repeated lower value, and that high-water never decreases. Update the envelope in the same reviewed change whenever scope or coverage advances. A fixed-scope floor may move downward only to the exact minimum directly observed by clean runs on the identical source, tests, and total-line scope, with linked evidence and a bounded tolerance; unexplained coverage loss remains a regression.

tolerance.rationale: The combined rebased #128 and #176/#538/#550 client changes extend modal-history ownership, private navigation suppression, nested-modal accessibility, and navigation-ledger coverage in the instrumented client/core scope. Three clean Node 22.20/V8 runs on 2026-08-02 each passed all 2,011 tests across 243 files with zero unhandled errors and reproduced exactly 2,808/3,201 (87.723%). Relative to the reviewed #128 main baseline of 2,738/3,128 (87.532%), the combined tree adds 73 instrumented lines and 70 covered lines while increasing coverage percentage. The exact observed envelope needs no instrumentation tolerance, so the new floor is 2,808/3,201 (87.723%). coverage-baseline.test.js retains the exact below-floor, above-baseline, scope-change, observed-high-water, and broad-tolerance negative boundaries.

The #650 EP-03.3 change adds the authoritative fingerprint/generation-bound installed-provider registry, closed lifecycle and admin command contracts, immutable whole-revision snapshots, consume-time elevated-user reauthorization, current-generation authority release, deterministic bounded persistence, store-wide corruption/capacity fencing, and eight immutable evidence-preserving recovery epochs without adding routes, provider execution, startup work, companion credentials, deployment, or Android/client work. Three clean local .NET 10.0.9 Coverlet runs and two clean Ubuntu CI runs on the identical final 50,031-line source and test scope each passed all 3,783 tests and measured 40,496, 40,498, 40,496, 40,500 and 40,502 covered lines. The reviewed observed high-water is therefore 40,502/50,031 (80.954%) and the exact observed floor is 40,496/50,031 (80.942%); the six-line schedule-dependent concurrency instrumentation spread is bounded to 0.012 percentage points. Relative to the #647 baseline of 39,220/48,671 (80.582%), the change adds 1,360 instrumented lines and at least 1,276 covered lines while increasing overall coverage. Focused cancellation, stale-authority, mixed-race, exact-bound, failed-write, corruption and repeated-recovery regressions plus independent architecture/security/test review cover the authority-critical paths. #648 remains the explicit nonreturning-filesystem isolation residual. coverage-baseline.test.js retains the exact scope-drift, regression, stale-baseline, observed-high-water, spread, single-run, and broad-tolerance negative boundaries.
